current_text.html: Ministers in good standing in other Presbyteries, or in any evangelical church, being present at any meeting of Presbytery, may be invited to sit as visiting brethren. It is proper for the moderator to introduce these brethren to the Presbytery. This provision shall also apply to the General Assembly.

metadata.synopsis: A complaint challenged Presbytery’s institution of two charges against a teaching elder and related pretrial actions. The SJC annulled the household-management charge because process began fifteen months after the alleged offense and the record showed no recently flagrant, newly evident, or continuing offense under BCO 32-20. It also held that declaring the elder not in good standing removed rights without process, but left his properly imposed suspension effective. It rejected objections to discussion, questioning, and the timely submission charge, which could proceed without any determination of guilt.
